properties.name: Relate
properties.purpose: Recording what a node relates to — and the judgement when nothing does. Holds review_relations (one door for both outcomes, refusing when given neither), has_review_relation (direction-blind on purpose, so the second node of every pair is not reported as an orphan) and unreviewed_ideas (the population the aggregate finding ranges over). Placed beside detect rather than inside it: this module WRITES the judgement the detector READS, and folding them together would let the detector's convenience shape what a person is asked to record.
